scope: Connected GUI-session magnifier source review: agent policy, capture target binding, deferred export, settings/state synchronization, and UI eligibility.
review: Configure Off requires session-control and an active permitted virtual user; enabling additionally requires capture permission and the currently selected allowed application target. Refresh and Export require capture permission and the same selected-target checks. Desktop-source capture remains standalone-only.

Connected PNG export uses an immutable completed cached frame. Encoding and same-directory atomic publication run on a bounded worker with a single pending export slot. Authorization is rechecked before approval and at completion. Pre-commit denial produces no filesystem write; if authorization changes after commit or the completion deadline passes, the correlated error states that an already committed/pending file cannot be rolled back or may still be published.

Magnifier settings are projected into both the agent profile snapshot and virtual-user state, and successful local/agent Configure requests update the virtual-user seat settings. GUI external acknowledgements update telemetry/profile without consuming a pending local command; successful local configure refreshes region fields. A valid cached frame remains exportable during a newer capture in flight.
limits: Source review only; native acceptance was not performed by this reviewer.
This approval covers the connected MCP/GUI path only. Existing local/standalone export remains synchronous and is outside the new asynchronous I/O guarantee.
Connected capture is limited to the currently selected allowed application window; desktop-source capture is not exposed through the connected path.
